india.one_line: India tops ChatGPT usage while AI wealth startup PowerUp Money raises $10 million.

themes.title: India leads ChatGPT usage
themes.text: India now has the highest weekly active user count for ChatGPT worldwide, with the user base doubling since January 2026. OpenAI is expanding local computing capacity, Indian-language features, Android‑first products, and plans UPI‑related announcements.

stories.headline: India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026

themes.title: PowerUp Money secures $10 million
themes.text: PowerUp Money raised $10 million in a round led by Flourish Ventures to develop its AI‑powered wealth advisory platform and expand its managed advisory service Infinite, which serves over 1.5 million users and holds nearly Rs 500 crore in assets under management.

stories.headline: PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India
